tasks.title: Merge PDF files online, free
tasks.description: Combine PDF files in your browser, arrange their order, and download one PDF. No file uploads or account needed.
tasks.limits: Up to 10 PDFs and 40 MiB total. Encrypted files are unsupported. Digital signatures and editable forms are not preserved.
tasks.sample: Two PDFs → one PDF with 3 pages.

tasks.title: Extract pages from a PDF online, free
tasks.description: Select PDF page numbers or ranges, keep the order you specify, and download a new PDF without uploading your file.
tasks.limits: Up to 40 MiB. Encrypted files are unsupported. Page numbers start at 1. Duplicate page numbers appear once.
tasks.sample: Two-page PDF → pages 2,1 in a new PDF.

tasks.title: Compress an image online, free
tasks.description: Compress a PNG, JPEG or WebP image locally in your browser. Adjust quality and dimensions, preview the image, and compare actual file sizes.
steps: Set format, quality and size limits
tasks.limits: PNG, JPEG or WebP inputs up to 25 MiB and 40 megapixels. Exact target bytes are not guaranteed. JPEG uses a white background for transparency. Metadata and animation are not preserved.

tasks.title: Resize an image online without cropping
tasks.description: Resize an image to fit your chosen width and height, preserve its proportions, and download a JPEG or WebP. Files stay in your browser.
tasks.limits: Fits inside the dimensions you enter, without cropping or enlarging. PNG, JPEG and WebP inputs; JPEG or WebP output. Metadata and animation are not preserved.

tasks.title: Remove duplicate rows from a CSV online
tasks.description: Remove duplicate CSV rows by all columns or a chosen key. Keep the first or last record, preview the result, and download the cleaned CSV.
steps: Choose a CSV or paste text
tasks.limits: UTF-8 CSV with a unique header per column, up to 10 MiB. Matching is exact unless you enable trimming or case folding. Pasted text takes priority over a file.
tasks.sample: 4 data rows → 3 rows after removing one exact duplicate.

tasks.title: Convert CSV to a JSON array online
tasks.description: Convert CSV rows into a JSON array of objects, with column headers as keys. Keep leading zeros and quoted text without uploading a file.
steps: Choose a CSV or paste text
tasks.limits: UTF-8 CSV with unique, non-empty column headers, up to 10 MiB. All values remain strings. Header whitespace is trimmed. Preview shows up to 8 rows; download includes all rows.
